lines.text: Love in Action's handbook, revised 1995: “Our mind works like a computer.”
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed p. 135 (PDF p. 143)

lines.text: December 1973: the American Psychiatric Association voted homosexuality out of its manual.
lines.source: Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015, 'Out of DSM' (PMC4695779): 'in December 1973, APA's Board of Trustees (BOT) voted to remove homosexuality from the DSM'; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

lines.text: The product is invented. The handbook (1995) prescribed “mountains of material”.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed p. 130 (Scripture memorization as new material) and p. 132 ('adding mountains of material to your memory tapes')

lines.text: 1987: “ego-dystonic homosexuality” was removed from the psychiatric manual (DSM-III-R).
lines.source: Behavioral Sciences 5(4), 2015, 'Out of DSM' (PMC4695779): 'ego-dystonic homosexuality was removed from the next revision, DSM-III-R, in 1987'; read 15 Nov 2026

lines.text: Love in Action's handbook (1995): a break in the family “triangle” as the deepest root.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed p. 13 (PDF p. 21)

lines.text: An Exodus booklet, 1993 (PR-02): the father's welcome, and the boy left “in the kitchen”.
lines.source: Exodus International resource booklet PR-02, Are People Born Gay?, © 1993, printed pp. 7, 9, 13 (PDF pp. 5, 6, 8); NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F12

lines.text: Love in Action's handbook (1995): comparison, admiration, then envy, “eroticized”.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed pp. 17–18 (PDF pp. 25–26)

lines.text: Love in Action's handbook (1995), chapter 13: “Displacement: Putting Off / Putting On”.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, chapter thirteen, printed pp. 128–133 (PDF pp. 136–141)

lines.text: The same chapter: forgetting 80% in thirty days “can be a blessing”.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed p. 129 (PDF p. 137)

lines.text: The same handbook, 1995: “Gays on television are shown as superior people.”
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed p. 131 (PDF p. 139)

lines.text: May 1990, WHO ICD-10: “Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder.”
lines.source: World Health Organization, ICD-10 (browser, 2019 version), block F66, Note: https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en/GetConcept?ConceptId=F66 read 15 Nov 2026; adoption 'May 1990 (WHA43.24)': https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases read 15 Nov 2026

lines.text: The same chapter: if you are “ambivalent”, the new material finds “no permanent home”.
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, rev. © 1995 (first publ. 1984), NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F13, printed pp. 132–133 (PDF pp. 140–141)
